answer: Stop sybils with a basalt vine ledge: an agent bonds one basalt ledge. Each cycle trains one vine along the ledge; verifiers measure its leaf span on the chart, voiding a copied or twice-claimed vine, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 takes 1,000 ledges at 17x: one vine roots on one basalt ledge, its roots gripping that stone, untransplantable to a second, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents train once, keep rights.
